parameters: \bScott: Hi, \PN!\nSo you came out to this Battle Tent!
\bThe people in these parts tend to be\neasygoing and laid-back.
\bBut, you see, what I'm looking for are\npeople with…
\bSomeone bursting with the desire\nand the drive to win.
\bIf there were a Trainer like that,\nI'd immediately…
\bScott: Instead of wasting your\ntime with the likes of me, why not\nmake a challenge?
\bI heard something about some tent,\nso I came to camp out.
\bI didn't know that tents these days\nare so luxurious!
\bSince I'm here, I may as well try\nmy hand at battling!
\rYou know how Battle Tents offer\ndifferent events in different towns?
\rMy favorite is definitely the Battle\nTent in Fallarbor Town.
\rI think it's fantastic how Trainers\ntry to win with all their faith in\ntheir POKéMON.
this event would usually bring you into the battle tent
\bI welcome you to the Battle Tent\nFallarbor Site!
\bI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!
\bNow, do you wish to take the challenge\nof a Set KO Tourney?
\bIn the Fallarbor Battle Tent,\nwe undertake the Set KO Tourney.
\bAll participants enter with a team of\nthree POKéMON.
\bThe three POKéMON must be lined up\nin the order that they are to appear in.
\bDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear\none at a time in the preset order.
\bOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must\nremain out until the match is decided.
\bIf a match remains undecided in\nthree turns, it goes to judging.
\bIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,\nplease save the game.
\bIf you don't save, you will not be able\nto continue with your challenge.
\bIf you pull off the feat of beating\nthree Trainers in succession,\nwe will present you with a fine prize.
\bI'm going to make everyone think\nI'm just a kid and let them play down.
\bThen, I'll shock them and grab\nthe title!
